sn5.10:1.2: Although these verses are much-quoted in Buddhist literature, Vajirā is only known from this Sutta.
sn5.10:2.1: The challenge is the same as the previous, with “sentient being” for “puppet”.
sn5.10:5.2: Compare Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 2.5.15 and Chāndogya Upaniṣad 7.15.1, where all beings are fixed in Divinity like spokes in the hub of a wheel.
